title: Approval
description: A human decision on a consequential action (ADR-0009). The record binds to subjectHash — the content hash of exactly what was approved — and the engine re-verifies it on resume. Without that binding an approval is a time-of-check/time-of-use bug with a human in it.

schemaVersion.description: ADR-0024 §5: stored documents are versioned as data. One version exists in V1.

kind.description: LOCAL_OPERATOR_CONSENT is self-asserted: the platform can attest that someone at the keyboard consented, not who they were. EXTERNAL_ATTESTATION borrows identity from a system that has it — a GitHub review, a Jira transition — and is the stronger form precisely because the platform is not the one asserting it.

requiredKind.description: What policy demanded, computed as the strictest of the tool's side-effect class, the repository trust level and the graph node definition (ADR-0009 §2). Any layer may require a stronger kind; none may require a weaker one.

renderingHash.description: Hash of what the human was actually shown. Recorded separately from subjectHash because approving a rendering that differs from the subject is the failure this pair exists to detect.

decidedBy.description: A local identity, or the verified external actor when kind is EXTERNAL_ATTESTATION.

expiresAt.description: Approvals expire. An indefinitely valid approval on a run that resumes weeks later is an approval of something nobody is still thinking about.

reRequestOf.description: ADR-0025 §2. The approvalId of the expired approval this one replaces. Present only on a re-request, which copies subjectHash and subjectRef unchanged: retrying an expired approval re-asks about the same subject and never re-executes the node, because re-execution could change what is being approved.

interactive.description: False when approved non-interactively (ADR-0018 §4). Recorded rather than forbidden, so that a batch-approved run is visibly distinguishable in the audit trail from one a human actually looked at.

externalRef.description: Pull request review id, Jira transition id, or equivalent, when kind is EXTERNAL_ATTESTATION.
